headline_item.title_zh: 为了应对人工智能驱动的错误发现，Anthropic 将高危和危急问题的协调漏洞披露窗口从 90 天缩短至 30 天 (Anthropic)
headline_item.title_en: Anthropic cuts its coordinated vulnerability disclosure window from 90 to 30 days for high- and critical-severity issues, in response to AI-driven bug discovery (Anthropic)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 在过去的几个月里，前沿模型在发现漏洞方面变得更加出色。我们仍然乐观地认为，这将帮助防御者比以往更快地发现和修复漏洞。然而，人工智能改进的速度改变了我们对自己的披露实践的看法
headline_item.event_summary_en:
Over the last several months, frontier models have become much better at discovering vulnerabilities. We remain optimistic that this will help defenders find and fix vulnerabilities faster than ever before. However, the speed at which AI is improving has changed how we think about our own disclosure practices.

We’re shortening the disclosure window in our coordinated vulnerability disclosure (CVD) policy from 90 days to 30 days for high- and critical-severity issues, and to 45 days for all othe

【起因与机理】前沿模型研发面临海量数据抓取合规争议与创作者信任危机，亟需构建透明可信的追溯机制与合理的版权利益分配方案。

We’re expanding the ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program to give up to 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to ChatGPT.

New tools, practical guidance, and partnerships will help prevent, detect and respond to online child sexual exploitation and abuse.

titans.quote_zh:
在我们对 ChatGPT 学术研究人员计划的 1,800 多名参与者进行的研究中，科学家们报告称，人工智能使他们的工作效率几乎翻了一番。

使用隐私保护方法，我们研究了他们如何在工作中使用 ChatGPT——从开发想法到分析数据和编写代码——以及它对科学发现的意义。
titans.quote_en:
Scientists reported nearly doubling their productivity with AI in our study of more than 1,800 participants in the ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program.

Using privacy-preserving methods, we looked at how they use ChatGPT across their work—from developing ideas to analyzing data and writing code—and what it could mean for scientific discovery.
